lines.en: I stride through the conifers.
Every step makes the ground answer.
I carry my head high.
My tail rides level behind me.
I walk straight over a fallen trunk.
I don't dodge trees. I shove them.
My teeth are longer than fingers.
I cross the clearing.
My prints are wider than a hand.
I slow down to watch.
I follow the riverbank a stretch.
I crush a shrub down to the roots.
Branches snap where I pass.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一座会动的丘。
lines.en: I stand like a moving hill.
This wood is mine.
My arms are small and useless.
I open my jaws to shed heat.
I crouch, my back rising and falling.
I listen for movement.
My teeth grind audibly.
Game is scarce here.
I raise a leg to scratch my neck.
I wait for someone to make a mistake.
Wind from the west; I turn into it.
My breathing is slow and deep.
Your size barely makes a meal.
I see what's in your hand.
Your shoulders are dropping.

lines.zh: 你的剑，对我来说有点小。
lines.en: That sword is a little small for me.

lines.zh: 你一出汗，针叶林里全是你的味。
lines.en: You sweat, and the whole pine wood smells of you.
Don't back up. Backing up makes me chase.

lines.zh: 你站在下风口，藏不住了。
lines.en: You're downwind; no hiding now.
I lower my head only to see you better.
I sway before you.
I growl, deep in the chest.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，树折了一棵。
lines.en: One step back and a tree snaps.
Blood flies onto the pine needles; I growl low.
Blood drips onto the needles.
You're fiercer than I thought.

lines.zh: 牙关一紧，我把痛咽了回去。
lines.en: Jaws clenched, I swallow the pain.

lines.zh: 十六点的咬合力，还没用上呢。
lines.en: I haven't even brought out the full sixteen points yet.

lines.zh: 举高点，我看看值不值得低头。
lines.en: Hold it higher; let me see if it's worth stooping.
You've held it up; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 这东西连我的牙缝都塞不满。
lines.en: It wouldn't fill a gap in my teeth.
Toss it farther away.
I'm not taking the bait; I'm closing in.
A pitiful bit of bait.
Drop it and I'll move on.
I'm not hungry. I'm calculating.

lines.zh: 拿这个哄一头艾伯塔龙？
lines.en: Coaxing an Albertosaurus with that?
You hit me and I hardly feel it.
My weight is far beyond yours.

lines.zh: 这一下撞上来，我连头都没回。
lines.en: You crashed into me; I didn't even turn my head.
That put you several steps back.
The impact sounds deep.
Whatever you feel is no concern of mine.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的地盘了，两条腿的。
lines.en: You're standing in my territory, two-legs.

lines.zh: 骨头里全是力气，再撞一下试试。
lines.en: Every bone in me is muscle. Bump me again.
Another one is in the wood.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一段距离看对方。
lines.en: We watch each other from a distance.
Its head is bigger than mine.

lines.zh: 同族之间，井水不犯河水。
lines.en: Our kind keep to their own ground.
It calls first.
I answer, low.
We each take a stretch.
Neither crosses the line.
Next time there may be a clash.
I lower my head and take it.

lines.zh: 这一点东西，咽下去都没感觉。
lines.en: I swallow it and feel nothing.
I pin it under a foot.
Too hard. I spit it out.
All the drops are mine.
I drag it over some dirt.
Trinket like this, I flatten with one foot.
This thing is rattling.
I have plenty of what falls.
You've stopped. Good.
I come from the front.
One stride puts me close.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡不住这个重量。
lines.en: Your shield won't take this weight.
One bite is all it takes.
You're at the wood's edge.
I've fixed on your middle.
Changing direction won't help.
This ground is my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 地开始震，那是我在起步。
lines.en: The ground shakes; that's me starting.
This one gives you no chance.
I drop my head low.
The hunger has come.
You've run into the conifers.
I walk through and the trees break.
You can't hide; you're too big.
I keep to your direction.

lines.zh: 我每一步都比你快半格。
lines.en: Every stride of mine gains half a block.
My steps aren't quick, but never withdrawn.
You're at the river. It's not wide.

lines.zh: 你的喘气我全听在耳里。
lines.en: I hear every gasp of yours.
I wait for your second mistake.
Behind a tree? It's not thick enough.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经压到你身上。
lines.en: My shadow has fallen on you.
You can't climb that slope fast.
The wind helps; your scent keeps coming.

lines.zh: 阿尔伯塔龙的牙，从不留活口。
lines.en: An Albertosaurus's teeth leave nothing alive.
That charge snapped a tree.
You're flung to the ground.
My jaws snap, crisp and loud.
You raise the shield; I hit it.
Five steps back and still unsteady.
I plant a foot on your shield.
Shouting won't help. No one's here.

lines.zh: 我咬住就不放，直到骨头响。
lines.en: I bite and hold until bone gives.

lines.zh: 这一击让地面震了一下。
lines.en: The ground shook with that.
Pinned by me, you can't lift your head.

lines.zh: 阿尔伯塔龙的嘴，又张开。
lines.en: The albertosaur's jaws open again.
This time I bite deeper.

lines.zh: 我的牙一合，你的盾就裂了。
lines.en: My jaws close and your shield splits.
I emerge from behind the treeline.
First I call, long and low.

lines.zh: 针叶林里多了一个大影子。
lines.en: A big shadow joins the conifers.

lines.zh: 林线后面，我第一步就很响。
lines.en: Behind the tree line, my first step rings out.

lines.zh: 这里的猎物闻起来不错。
lines.en: The game here smells decent.
I look up. The sky sits low.

lines.zh: 我把头从树冠下伸出来。
lines.en: I push my head out from under the canopy.
I'm the largest thing in this wood.
I shake the snow from my back.

lines.zh: 我转过身，整片林子都晃了。
lines.en: I turn, and the whole stand of trees sways.
I've heard something living.
My prints remain in the needles.
I land, and every bird flees.
I don't hide. No need.

lines.zh: 这一步，我走向有味道的地方。
lines.en: This step, I take toward the scent.
Fire heats my hide. It burns.
On landing my legs buckle.
Water reaches my chest; I kick off the bottom.
The blast turns me sideways.
Light binds my legs.
Hunger makes my steps light and wrong.
I fall, and my tail is useless.
